title: Statements, expressions, syntax
learningObjectives: Explain statements, expressions, syntax and create a small runnable JavaScript example.

understand.concept: An expression produces a value, while a statement performs an action or controls execution. JavaScript syntax defines how tokens and structures are written. Expressions can appear inside statements, such as assigning the result of an arithmetic expression to a variable.
understand.whyItMatters: Understanding the difference helps learners read code and diagnose syntax errors. A statement is not necessarily the same as a single line of text.
understand.analogy: An expression is a value-producing ingredient; a statement is an instruction that uses ingredients to do something.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; script loading and JavaScript evaluation follow browser parsing and language rules.

explain.narrative: price*0.18 and price+tax are expressions; the const declarations are statements.

examples.explanation: price*0.18 and price+tax are expressions; the const declarations are statements.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser page or developer console shows the result described in the example.

practise.guidedTask: Mark the expressions and statements in a short program. Add one expression inside a console.log statement.
practise.independentTask: Create a small page with an external or embedded script. Test its execution order and inspect the console for errors.
hints: Keep behaviour separate from semantic markup where practical.
Choose defer, async, or module based on dependencies and ordering.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Statements, expressions, syntax</title></head><body>
<script>const price=120;const tax=price*0.18;const total=price+tax;document.body.insertAdjacentText('beforeend','Total: '+total);</script>
</body></html>
practice.resetCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Statements, expressions, syntax</title></head><body>
<script>const price=120;const tax=price*0.18;const total=price+tax;document.body.insertAdjacentText('beforeend','Total: '+total);</script>
</body></html>

questions.prompt: Which of these produces a value?
questions.explanation: An expression evaluates to a value.

questions.prompt: What is a useful way to diagnose a JavaScript runtime issue?
options: Inspect the console and source location
questions.answer: Inspect the console and source location
questions.explanation: Developer tools show runtime messages and help locate the source of an issue.
